_about: How claim confidence is computed (tier 2, derived knowledge). Deterministic and versioned: bump formula_version whenever a weight changes so claim_confidence_history stays comparable. Nothing here is edited by the model.
_strengths_note: USER_ENTERED = Gate answers, sheet edits, engagement details, chat statements. MASTER_RESUME = the source template (S19). HISTORICAL_RESUME = R1–R16 and the consulting summary (S17); the newer authored_at wins ties. PUBLIC_PROFILE = the LinkedIn capture (S18). EXTERNAL_RESEARCH is about companies, never about Tim until he confirms. MODEL_INFERENCE never prints without corroboration. A job description is tier-2 input, not evidence.
